response.sql: SELECT c.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3) AS fraction_of_region, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY c.district_id, d.A3 ORDER BY fraction_of_total DESC LIMIT 10
